selection_rule: Among policies with positive mean after-tax full-project profit, loss frequency <=0.25 and insolvency frequency <=0.05 on base training worlds, maximize the tenth-percentile full-project profit. Tie-break by mean then lexicographic policy name. If none qualify, select stop. Always evaluate the highest-mean active policy on holdout as a diagnostic, regardless of stop selection.
note: Source/config frozen before training; holdout seeds were not used to select policy
